summary: postinstall fetches and executes a native binary from a bare-IP endpoint over unverified TLS
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script (ensurePlatformBinary) downloads a platform-specific tgz from the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz, extracts it into node_modules, chmods the extracted binary to 0755, and hardlinks it into bin/.onecode. The HTTPS request is made with rejectUnauthorized:false, disabling TLS certificate validation, and no hash or signature check is performed on the downloaded bytes. A bin wrapper subsequently spawns this binary when the CLI is invoked. The download source is a bare IP with no association to any publisher domain, and the delivery is trivially substitutable by anyone in a network-on-path position or by whoever controls that IP.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
